commitResults.messageTitle: Added Dr Pijon Graphics and Speech
Added Echo Functionality
Moved main function to new Main class
Added ability to store and display text
Added marking tasks, unmarking tasks, Task class and subclasses
Refactored marking and unmarking tasks
Used Codex to display an error when using invalid commands instead of crashing
Improve Java style and task output
commitResults.messageBody:
The Java sources lack consistent documentation, encapsulation, and naming,
which makes the task manager harder to maintain.

- Add Javadocs and override annotations to clarify the task model.
- Replace public mutable state and ambiguous names with private fields,
  constants, and descriptive task variables.
- Print only the updated task after mark or unmark commands.

Keep task behavior unchanged while making status updates clearer.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate project coding standards
commitResults.messageBody:
The project needs local guidance for consistent Java style and Git history management.

- Add project skills for the SE-EDU Java and Git conventions.
- Require those standards in AGENTS.md for future code and commits.

Make the standards discoverable and apply them consistently across the project.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Claude instructions with project standards
commitResults.messageBody: CLAUDE.md should state the same local requirements as the main agent instructions so all project agents follow one policy.\n\nAdd direct references to the project-specific Java and Git standards.

commitResults.messageTitle: Changed class structure of Task, Todo, and Deadline
Added Event class and changed input handling
Improved input handling to work for Todo, Deadline, and Event classes
Refactored main input handling
Place Java classes in a project package
commitResults.messageBody: The Java classes are in the default package, which makes ownership and imports less explicit as the project grows.\n\nAdd the lower-case drpijon package to every application class. Keep runtime behavior unchanged while making the project structure explicit.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace global task storage with a task list
commitResults.messageBody: The command loop stores tasks in a fixed array and tracks the next position through global state. This couples unrelated methods and duplicates manual count updates.\n\nUse a List<Task> so storage and collection size remain together. Let the list provide task indexing and count information, which removes the capacity magic number, global taskCount, and repeated increment logic without changing the user-visible commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Display event start time correctly
commitResults.messageBody: Event creation reports both endpoints in its confirmation, but the start-time field reads the end-time value. This makes valid event input appear incorrect to the user.\n\nRead the event's from value for the from field so the confirmation reflects the data that was entered.

commitResults.messageTitle: Validate structured task input
commitResults.messageBody: Deadline and event commands index delimiter parts without checking their presence, so incomplete input can terminate the application with an exception.\n\nValidate the required sections before constructing structured tasks and reuse a named invalid-input message. Keep valid commands unchanged while making malformed input fail safely.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document the event task model
commitResults.messageBody: Event is a public task type but provides no class or constructor documentation, which makes its time-range semantics less clear to maintainers.\n\nAdd concise Javadocs describing the event model and its constructor parameters. Keep the implementation and runtime behavior unchanged.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify command processing flow
commitResults.messageBody: Main handles startup, input parsing, command dispatch, and output framing in one method, which makes the control flow harder to read and maintain.\n\nSeparate the command loop from command dispatch and use an explicit switch with a default case. Keep each method at one logical level while preserving the existing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Wrap long event output statement
commitResults.messageBody: The event confirmation line exceeds the project's 120-character readability limit, making the surrounding output code harder to scan.\n\nWrap the format call at natural argument boundaries without changing the rendered event message.
